HR driven IT automation

Full device lifecycle management

Manage devices from first shipment through offboarding in one system. Tracking, repairs, recovery, and reuse are handled as part of the same lifecycle.

Support built into the platform

FAQs

We don’t have an IT team—can we still use Deel IT?

Yes. Deel IT handles setup, shipping, tracking, and lifecycle so you don’t need an internal IT team.

We already manage devices internally—what does Deel IT actually replace?

It removes the manual work of configuring devices, installing apps, shipping globally, and managing returns.

Is this only for large companies?

No. Small teams especially benefit because Deel IT becomes their IT function.

Does Deel IT replace our current IT tools?

No. It complements your tools by handling the physical devices and global logistics they don’t cover.

Can we use Deel IT with our existing devices?

Yes. Deel IT works with company-owned devices, new purchases, or a mix.

Can Deel IT scale with our hiring and global growth?

Yes. It’s designed for distributed teams and works consistently in 130+ countries. We also have bundles especially dedicated to growing companies stages and needs

How does Deel IT handle application access and security for employees?

Deel IT automates application access and security based on role and employment status. When someone joins, changes roles, or leaves, access is granted or revoked automatically using your existing identity and security tools. This keeps systems secure without manual IT work or tickets.

What happens when employees need IT help after onboarding?

Employees get 24/7 global IT support for device, access, and technical issues, no matter where they are located. Deel IT handles day-to-day support so internal teams are not stuck troubleshooting routine problems or managing tickets across time zones.

How does Deel IT handle returns, repairs, or lost devices?

Deel IT takes care of replacements, tracking, shipping labels, and compliance-safe offboarding.
